title: November 18 — WaveFormer: resonant recurrence with attention
summary: WaveFormer V1's wave lead at 48 tokens is ablation-negative. Three uploaded V2 seed receipts now enforce a local-attention cutoff: at 48 tokens full attention 86.52%, local-only 25.98%, leaky recurrence 95.51%, and phase-rotating wave recurrence 55.34%. Disabling either recurrent head drops results to chance. Recurrent memory is necessary here; phase rotation loses to plain leaking.

nodes.claim: Tiny two-block WaveFormer V1 compares attention and phase-rotating or leaky second heads; V2 constrains attention to a local 4-token window so distant role memories can only cross via recurrence.
nodes.survived: V1 24-token accuracy reaches 100% in all arms, and at 48 tokens wave is 83.01%, but V1 recurrent ablation is null. V2 three trained seeds (42–44; 512 held-out episodes/length/seed): at 48 tokens full attention 86.52%, local-only 25.98% (chance 25%), leaky recurrence 95.51%, wave recurrence 55.34%. With recurrent pathways ablated leaky drops to 24.48% and wave to 24.22%. The trained recurrence is therefore causally load-bearing on this synthetic task.
nodes.killed: V1: wave 83.01% intact vs 83.14% head-zeroed at 48, so attention carried that result. In V2 phase rotation loses to nonoscillatory leak in each of the three seeds (leaky 95.51% vs wave 55.34% at length 48; 61.85% vs 41.02% at length 96). The recurrent head uses sequential Python; no wave efficiency, improved general reasoning, or autonomous ongoing thought shown. README still says trained V2 pending even though results/v2 JSON receipts are committed.

edges.why: Off-token concept transfer motivates a learned recurrent read/write interface, but there is no shared implementation.
The two-form content/prediction distinction informs a proposed resonant head; waves have not yet earned a numerical advantage.
Distributed persistent context motivates future local gates, not yet implemented in WaveFormer.

motifs.title: Precise attention alongside persistent recurrent state
motifs.description: Under a forced local-attention cutoff, recurrent memory becomes essential; on this role-retrieval task leaky recurrence substantially outperforms phase-rotating recurrence across three seeds.
